messages:
Ava (Growth): Heads up — pushing the messaging alpha to production for the webinar follow-up drip. Need a quick readout for tomorrow's AM KPI review: surface 72h opens, click->lead conversion, and any routing drop-offs by source. Rolling canary 10% -> 100% over 48h. :rocket:
Ravi (Product Marketing): Noted. Can we get variant A vs B split by those metrics? Last test showed +6% open for B but higher CPL.
Sam (Analytics): I can pull those. Which attribution windows do you want — 24h, 72h, 7d? And confirm experiment split was 50/50?
Ava (Growth): Use 72h as primary, 7d as secondary. Yes 50/50. Also include median time-to-convert and per-channel CPL.
Lena (Content): Also surface landing bounce and scroll depth for each variant — I've seen higher early exits on B in the last run.
Sam (Analytics): Will do. Quick FYI — we saw ~2.3% of leads missing UTM due to a redirect rule; I'll flag how that might bias channel counts.
Ravi (Product Marketing): Can we implement a fallback UTM mapping for those cases? Also note copy difference: A = "Register now", B = "Get instant access" — could be semantic CTR lift.
Lena (Content): I'm pushing a microcopy update for variant B (tightening hero) at 11:15.
deploy-bot: deploy started by Lena — campaign-message-alpha -> canary (build 5832).
Sam (Analytics): Running funnel counts now. Expect a quick dashboard (~90m). I'll include confidence intervals and p-values for A/B.
Ava (Growth): If CTR delta >15% or MQL rate drops below baseline, pause rollout and revert to A. Also include routing breakdown: SFDC queue vs HubSpot, and any leads landing in "manual-review".
Sam (Analytics): Got it. I'll surface queue-level drop-offs. Note from last launch a GTM rule routed ~7% to manual-review which delayed SLA.
Ravi (Product Marketing): Add alerting to the dashboard for routing spikes >5% to manual-review.
Lena (Content): I'll coordinate with Ops to clear manual queue thresholds while we run the canary.
Sam (Analytics): Preliminary after 2 hours: A CTR 4.2% vs B 4.6% (p=0.12), opens A 24% B 26%, conversions A->lead 1.8% B 2.0%. No obvious routing skew yet.
Ava (Growth): That looks fine so far. Sam — please include lead quality signals (org size, job title) so we can see if B brings worse leads.
Sam (Analytics): Will add a small table of quality proxies and baseline MQL conversion.
Ravi (Product Marketing): For the AM KPI review, I need a one-slide summary: top metric, current delta, proposed action, and risk. Who owns the slide?
Ava (Growth): I'll own the slide and the ask to PMs. Sam — can you paste the dashboard link once ready?
Sam (Analytics): Posting link now — https://internal.redwood.ai/dashboards/campaigns/5832 . I'll drop a short notes block with CIs and the UTM missing-rate adjustment.
Ava (Growth): Perfect. Quick reminder: monitor delivery skew — if any channel overindexes for B due to ESP timing, pause.
Ravi (Product Marketing): Added to the slide notes. Also flag any large landing bounce (>10% delta).
Lena (Content): Will monitor creative performance and standby to roll the hero back if bounce spikes.
Sam (Analytics): Updated dashboard and one-pager attached in the dashboard share. Will DM raw counts to Ava.
Ava (Growth): Thanks everyone — see you at the AM KPI review. If anything critical happens overnight, ping #oncall-marketing. :phone: 
Ravi (Product Marketing): Thanks team.
Lena (Content): Thx!
deploy-bot: build 5832 canary complete — traffic at 10%.
